checks.name: Retired streamed agents and regions release real navigation caches
Missing target stops actual entity velocity immediately before repath deadline and rejoins safely
Disabled target is not silently replaced with the agent itself
Imported handoff cannot mutate unrelated cells or the owning cell root
Partial handoff preserves disabled state and replay restores finite captured motion deterministically

scope: Production navigation cache/target lifecycle and streamed transform/velocity handoff ownership. Does not claim full world rollback, network replay or physical-device qualification.
